concepts.description: What the package is and where things live: headless hooks plus descriptor trees, peer deps, the source -> view -> gate flow, layers by file, the public API list

RuleBuilderSource and narrowing layers (relations off until the first layer turns them on), composeNarrowed (the gate lens), builderSource, withAllRelations, resolve/createView/rawView, LensView, viewRoot/viewAt/visitOf

What one scope offers: describeScopeFields/describeModelFields -> BuilderField (kind, operators intersected across targets, enum/sourced options, groupBy, relation target, acceptsSubPath) and valueShapeForOperator slot shapes

Data-backed field options: narrowing `sources`, json-rules toSourceQueries/materializeSourceQuery/materializeSources producing sourceValues passed to resolve/useRuleBuilder and riding the visit at their path
Lens walks for consumers outside the rule tree: lensValuePicker/useLensValuePicker (value locations to maxDepth) and lensScopeSurface/useLensScopeSurface (flat values plus to-many loop portals)
Persisting a rule with its binding: SavedRule {source, rule, sourceValues?}, stringifySavedRule, parseSavedRule (validated, throws)
useRuleBuilder options and {value, root, lens, view, setCondition, validate, describe}: the gate (validateRuleInLens + validateRule per target), coerceRule, describeRule, per-control valid
buildRoot/asRoot and the GroupNode/LeafNode/ArrayNode descriptors with field/operator/value controls and bound actions; how a renderer maps ValueControl modes to inputs
ArrayNode presence/count/predicate, nested condition and filter groups, sum/avg AggregateControl, $./$$./$$$. scope refs via LeafNode.scopes and value.path.scopes
useFilteredCollection over rows in hand: options materialized from rows, `data` = rows passing check(), engineGlobals rulesBuilder.filter.caseInsensitive/fuzzy defaults

Pure path-addressed Condition edits (RulePath, getNode/setNode/removeNode/addRule/wrapInCompound/groupSiblings/unwrapCompound/normalizeGroups/asGroupRoot) and editor meta (withIds, stripMeta, trimEmptyGroups, switchGroupOperator)

Presentational Decoration: path facets (leaf/collection/branch), labels and relabelRelations, fixed `where` vs editable `defaultWhere`, kind retype, move-not-copy, rehydration via matchFacet/stampFacetIds, validateDecoration, useFacetFields
Preset facets (`condition`, atomic nodes) with Variable value slots {default, options, range}: presetSeed, variableSlots, isPreset, VariableControl, preset matching
Per-model facets (Decoration.models), Facet.selectors with selectorClauses/setSelectorClause/writeSelectorClause, groupBy partition pinning, faceted/raw facetMode toggle backed by __facetId
Splitting one physical relation into tagged logical sources by leading `where` slices and adjoining them; decoration is curation, lens narrowing is security; deferred `scope` sugar; no auto-discovery
usePermissionBuilder over a RebacSchema, useActionRuleBuilder over one ActionRule (delegate, rel/action, self, rule, any, all), buildActionRoot descriptors, actionTree/schema helpers over rawView
useTransitionBuilder over a TransitionMap (resource -> action -> paths {from, to}): predicate/permission roots per side, to.merge spread/deepMerge/append/appendUnique, transitionTree helpers
